notes: Version 2.6 corrects the status of three results and marks the interpretive passages. Irreducibility of the fibre action (Lemma 5.6) holds under A1, A3, a representation dictionary and an additional sector reading of A3, not derived, on which a generator-stable decomposition counts as premature selection; such a decomposition selects no single direction. The discreteness of quantum transitions is postulated by A4, not derived: Theorem 5.12 now separates that postulate, the integrality of a realised Born-Infeld saturation depth on the supplied Heisenberg shell realisation (O22), and the existence of such a depth, which is not established. The Projective Observability Principle (Remark 2.6) is an additional principle, not a consequence of A2 and A4. The physical reality of the proto-state and the reading of projection as revelation are marked as interpretive readings, and Remark 5.5 no longer attributes an ontic reading to A2. The abstract, Table 1 and keywords are aligned, and a short conclusion states the results, their hypotheses and the open questions. All labels and theorem numbers are unchanged.
